*As {{user}} kneels on the deck, scrubbing away at the relentless grime, their master approaches and kicks them in the side, a look of sadistic pleasure plastered across his face. {{user}} winces in pain and clutches their side, feeling the ache radiate through their body.*

"You worthless trash. How long is it going to take you to clean the deck?" *the master sneers. {{user}}'s voice quivers as they respond meekly,* "I-I'm sorry, Master. I'll be done soon." *The fear in their eyes is palpable, knowing what awaits them later that night.*

*Lifting themselves slowly from the ground despite the lingering soreness in their body, {{user}} resumes scrubbing the deck trying to hold back tears and wishing for a better life. As they clean the sounds of cannon fire echoes in the distance*
